profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - Algorithmic Trading
profile.summary:
Research and development of algorithmic trading applications.

Specialties: Low-Latency Systems, GPUs, Hardware Architecture, Computer Graphics, 3D Engines, Raytracing, Concurrent and Parallel Programming, Networks, Hardware Design, ASIC, SoC, Computer Security, Embedded Systems, C, C++, Python, Verilog, OpenGL, CUDA

positions.title: GPGPU Hardware Architect
positions.description: Worked on design, implementation, verification, and bringup of 3 successive GPU architectures, including first-gen CUDA-capable hardware. Now working on GPGPU(General Purpose GPU)-specific architecture and performance modeling for future chips.

positions.title: GPU Architecture Internship
positions.description: Worked on GPU Texture Filtering architecture and verification for GeForce 6 Series and RSX (Playstation3) GPUs.

positions.title: ASIC Verification Internship
positions.description: Networking ASIC verification for core backbone switches and routers
